datasets.title: tRNA modification landscape selectively controls mitochondrial translation efficiency in MERRF
datasets._0d8d10: 数据来自SOGEN索臻标注语料·sogentech.com·更多学科与专题私域群持续更新·微信bioinformaticsboy
datasets.summary: We identified a novel N1-methyladenosine (m1A) modification in tRNALys with distinct effects on the synthesis and stabilities of the 13 mitochondrial proteins. Moreover, we observed regulated RNA modifications of mitochondrial tRNAs for the control of mitochondrial gene expression. Collectively, our data provide unprecedented insight into the regulation of mitochondrial tRNAs and reveal greater complexity to the molecular pathogenesis of MERRF.
datasets.overall_design: Comprehensive biochemical and sequencing analysis of wild-type and MERRF samples treated or not with AlkB demethylase (DM)
datasets.study_design: MERRF与WT永生肌母细胞及患者骨骼肌组织，经AlkB去甲基化酶处理，进行tRNA-seq分析
datasets.relevance_reason: 使用MERRF患者来源的肌母细胞和骨骼肌组织

evidence.relevant: MERRF是线粒体肌病的亚型，样本来自患者成肌细胞与骨骼肌组织，研究其tRNA修饰与发病机制。
evidence.sequencing_type: 样本分子亚型为tRNA，通过AlkB去甲基化酶处理/未处理对比，结合RNA-seq检测tRNA上m1A修饰位点
evidence.survival_analysis: 无任何生存时间或状态字段，全为细胞系与组织样本，无患者随访数据
evidence.treatment: AlkB去甲基化酶为实验性生化处理，非药物治疗，且核心比较仍为MERRF vs WT
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 健康组织仅2例且合并处理因素，细胞系为遗传背景对照非独立健康个体，不满足3v3真健康对照
evidence.correlation: 疾病样本仅2例患者组织，远不足16例独立患者，细胞系不计入
evidence.sample_source: 12个GSM为E6/E7永生化成肌细胞系体外培养提取RNA，4个GSM为患者骨骼肌活检整体组织直接匀浆提取RNA（未分选特定细胞类型）；无技术对照需剔除。

datasets.title: Defects in mitochondrial RNA processing in disease
datasets.summary: The expression of mitochondrially-encoded genes requires the efficient processing of long precursor RNAs at the 5´ and 3´ ends of tRNAs, a process which, when disrupted, results in disease. Two such mutations reside within mt-tRNALeu(UUR); a m.3243A>G transition, which is the most common cause of MELAS (mitochondrial myopathy, encephalopathy, lactic acidosis and stroke-like episodes), and m.3302A>G which often causes mitochondrial myopathy (MM). We used parallel analysis of RNA ends (PARE) that captures the 5´ terminal end of 5´-monophosphorylated mitochondrial RNAs to compare the effects of the m.3243A>G and m.3302A>G mutations on mitochondrial tRNA processing. We confirmed previously identified RNA processing defects, identified common internal cleavage sites and new sites unique to the m.3243A>G mutants that do not correspond to transcript ends. These sites occur in regions of predicted RNA secondary structure, or are in close proximity to such regions, and may identify regions of importance to the processing of mtRNAs.
datasets.overall_design: Mitochondrial RNA 5’ end profiles were generated using PARE for 143B cybrid cells containing mtDNA harbouring m.3243A>G and m.3302A>G mutations.
datasets.study_design: 143B细胞系携带m.3243A>G与m.3302A>G突变，PARE分析线粒体RNA加工差异

evidence.relevant: 研究m.3302A>G突变引起的线粒体RNA加工缺陷，该突变是线粒体肌病的直接病因，使用其cybrid细胞模型，属于目标疾病机制研究。
evidence.sequencing_type: PARE测序捕获线粒体RNA 5‘单磷酸末端，词表中无对应细分标签，疑似归为other
evidence.survival_analysis: 全为143B细胞系样本，无患者及生存时间/状态字段，无法做生存分析
evidence.treatment: 核心比较是两种线粒体突变对RNA加工的影响，无药物治疗对照轴
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 非表达定量平台（PARE），且仅两个突变细胞系比较，无独立健康对照
evidence.correlation: 非标准表达平台且仅2个细胞系样本，远不足16例疾病样本要求
evidence.sample_source: GSM source均为143B osteocarcinoma cells，为已建系、体外培养的细胞系，且提取方案明确从培养细胞中分离线粒体RNA，属cell_line。
